note: Weights, thresholds and rules were designed on the dev DAOs only. The test DAOs were fetched but not inspected (only their status counts) before the method was frozen.
post_freeze_changes: 2026-11-10: bug fix after the first test run. A risk agent that found no red flags emitted no claims, so the reviewer sent its section back and memos were scored without a risk section. Risk agents now always cite the proposer's earlier filings. No weight or threshold changed. Pre-fix test numbers: 63.6% agreement, 53.8% balanced accuracy (commit 05f8d9e).
